notes.title: D-Corp Arena Update with a new game mode is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hMXs9YbdAfs;full][/previewyoutube]

Attention robotic workers!

D-Corp planetary activities just got a whole lot more exciting!

This free update introduces PvP, player-versus-player gameplay. The lovable bitbots can finally hammer it out among themselves in the brand-new, team-building exercise called Arena Mode! 🔥

Assemble the crew, and get ready to fight for glory in the ultimate explosive showdown for 2 to 4 players. Who will collect the most scrap, and who gets to sit on the toilet throne?! 🪠

Our CEO, Mr. Brain-In-A-Jar, was quoted as saying, "We're thrilled for this great opportunity to encourage team spirit, boost profits, and have some good old-fashioned fun! Let's be honest, who doesn't love a little friendly competition?" 🧠

Enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285040/DCorp/

Full changelog:


 New game mode: Arena

 Arena mode introduces PvP (versus) gameplay 👹
 Accessed through level select menu
 Get most scrap and keep it to win 🧺
 Hit enemies to make them lose scrap 🔨
 Can be played with 2-4 players
 Fun is mandatory!

 New Planet: Explosion Factory 💥
 8 New Levels 🗺️

 Factory
 Furnace
 Hexapath
 Iron Beach
 King of the Cake
 Slag Pit
 The Maw
 Smelter

 12 New Hats to unlock 🤠
 New enemy: Loot Goblin 👺

notes.title: The Addendum Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/2a8ae25694661900f4d654d91ce3476d045865e5.png

The Addendum Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/09fd1d0d48be9fb6ce4b23f933c8ad9d5d7624db.png
Corporately mandated greetings!
In order to protect our profit margins on this planet, we have assigned some new areas for you lucky bots to explore and exploit for their natural resources! You may express your gratitude in whatever way you feel is adequate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/431238e0e6b124349cb180d03aa7305671c95a4e.png
These areas stretch across all the areas of the planet, from the surface all the way to the core. New challenges await, with appropriate secrets and rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/c7f20cacf633a8b2763286904e962568e3d164a4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/dca0946080c2cb26f8a0d7e3ca03ebd2ebf9fccf.gif
Our trusty Thumper has proved capable of [strike]severely damage[/strike] strategically reposition geological features in certain areas, which is highly useful in reaching previously unreachable resources. The sound of heavy machinery cracking the earth is the sound of progress!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/7517cfba65a09070562da83b3df2da682bde1c23.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5e82556acaa60a6786a6dec5eb0e23c95e41603e.gif
Thanks to our patented “Flush it Down” strategy, we have harnessed the natural currents of these acid rivers to greatly reduce shipping costs down to the sewers! Because of that, you will have the privilege of being provided with ANOTHER Flamethrower! As you now meet the minimum requirements to survive the area, this will be counted towards your allotted number of celebration events.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/33a3d7eaeae663f347c70822d29f0bde4bc2d6e1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/a6be76c54b4810adca34946fae60026885caca6e.gif
While our propaganda department is still adamantly refuting any signs of civilization on the planet, the newly discovered button-like “Rock Formations” down in the “Only Rocks Down Here” area seems to have some sort of “geological” connection to certain moving… “rock”… platforms.
As you can see, this place has been a challenge for our propagandologists…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/e994bc4d04fd1f361673fed41daad4f096bd9273.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/af2bb24b71790cff90569079c1a78e275806a480.gif
Without blaming anyone in management, the Tesla Turrets down there has been positioned in an [strike]incompetent[/strike] strategically inconvenient manner. Also, since the aforementioned manager doesn’t want to admit error and send a request for repositioning, it falls to you to figure out a way to keep the turrets up and running. Just make sure you don’t accidentally dump valuable Cactigen in the Garbage Eater! Thanks, I really appreciate, I mean, the MANAGER really appreciates it.


These new locations will even out the number of levels on each biome and hopefully make the difficulty curve, for newly constructed units, slightly less… deadly

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/83c7765c01ba374a5379827450a652ecba2ffea7.png
We have continued to note a worrying number of destroyed units, FAR above the “acceptable losses” planned for this year's budget. Therefore a new challenge system has been set in place that can be selected on a Level-to-Level basis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/ad4f694cb5acff3d7f7dee6bc2451f2414bfa4d0.gif

The old difficulty has simply changed name to “Challenging” with very few alterations. The new one is called “Normal”, with tweaks to enemy movement speed and similar variables.

Additionally, we have also approved the deployment of additional equipment when only ONE unit is operating. For example, one additional Turret has been provided on the “Thumper Thump” location when performing solo missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/7c07712aff61ea65376d43e04f5e673f897abce3.png
The Hot Bot Hat Pack for D-Corp is here! Customize your Bit-Bots to make them stand out from the workforce crowd. The quest of exploiting the planet for profit was never funkier.
The pack contains a stockpile of 11 cosmetic items (commonly known as hats)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/b281e9bbcb6f91a8ce38b0e26dd213f7217b65cc.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/f13902199ddb7637eb2efb327d8a1abca95cc62c.jpg

It's a great way to support the company, look a little bit cooler, and/or try to relive the glory days of Spellsworn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

If you notice any discrepancies in any department, be it audio, visual or mechanical, do not hesitate to contact us through our usual channels and forums. Twitter or Facebook.

Or join the Discord channel!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/e842860305dfd32d5f9c038359d9b6ad3672f4e1.png 

Now get down there and earn the company it’s well deserved place as “Still Technically the Top Third Resource Gathering Company in the Known Universe”!

Brain-in-a-jar
CEO D-Corp

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

FULL CHANGELOG
New Levels

 Surface biome
 Shaky Mountains
 Sewer biome
 Acidic Falls
 Lab biome
 The Motion
 The Switch
Gameplay

New difficulty settings

 Normal
 Challenging Added another turret on “Thumper thump” level if 1 player.
 Removed exploding enemy on “Thumper thump” level.
 Moved scrapable cactus on “Turn up the heat”  level to ease perspective problems.
 Added new customizations for finishing new level challenges.
 Added new cutscene between sewer and lab biomes.

Visuals

 Added new customizations for finishing new level challenges.
 Added two secret customizations hidden in new levels.
 Added a “rotate” notification to “Tutorial” and “First challenge” levels
 Added and removed props to increase clarity in “Tutorial” level
 Hide “Enemy paths” on level intros.
 Moved and shrunk “Brain in a jar” dialogue boxes.

Bugs

 Fixed issue when trying to drop things (ex: Ammo into turret) when standing in front of them.
 Fixed issue resulting in scrapable cacti spawning before boss appears in “Climactic Turtle” level.
 Fixed challenge not working properly on “Big Slime” level.
 Collision fixes on a few of the levels
 Fixed issue where enemies would randomly fall off on their own while being carried.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

With our limited time and resources I am proud and excited to give another update to D-Corp. It’s nice to be able to act on feedback and add some more value to the game. We are working on other things, such as localization and hoping to be able to port it to at least one of the major consoles soon™. We are also very proud of the DLC pack with  some cute new hats with a few Spellsworn references!

Thank You for Your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/f78a2542065285af9f4c2aff5bc18437208f7feb.png
Anders (@Cannonfood)
Frogsong Studios

notes.title: Update on the updates to come!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow humans!
This is an update to prepare you for the things we are currently working on. In the next couple of weeks we will release two major things. 

First!
We are adding a difficulty selection for each level! you will be able to choose between "Normal" and "Challenging". The "Hardcore button", found on each level ads a multiplier to the chosen difficulty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/9bf54528b6c0141cebf417cec792300b0673985c.png
It is found when selecting a level in the level selection menu.

Second!
A huge update to the game with Four new levels added seamlessly to the current selection. With this we hope to ease the learning curve a bit as well as give you more good times!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/657831cf08b56206ffbd490b2c8777b9ba68f691.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/04cbcf72e8304155847e33d20709037bd47d8706.png

Alongside the new levels of the update we will also introduce a ”difficulty selection” as well as a bunch of bug fixes and some quality of life tweaks. 

Third!
We will release a small DLC that can be purchased if you don’t think the customization's already in the game are enough. It will contain some references to our previous game as well as some other cool and cute stuff.

- posting on our Discord 💬

notes.title: D-Corp is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QZTEEO3Ctos;full][/previewyoutube]

Full version available

After 8 months of corporate effort that involved but was not limited to:

Scrapping, tweaking, fixes, digging, exploration, testing, propaganda, as well as LOTS of bureaucracy, and more...

After painstakingly taking notes from all your feedback...

Today is the day, finally!

🌵🤖 D-Corp is out of Early Access! 🔨🌵

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285040/DCorp/

Tell your friends!

May them come and support our noble cause of colonizing new planet and liberating its cactigen resources! Every bit bot matters!

Working in teams of 4 they will be able to bring glory (and profit! but mostly glory) to the company. All of this while looking awesome and wearing very fashionable hats that they will unlock during their labor.

They do not have even to gather in the same physical spot! Thanks to the mystical powers of Steam Remote Play Together, ability to connect from all corners of the world will just drop upon them.

Fresh content

Do you like when the company gives you free stuff every now and then, like t-shirts and pens? Well, with this noble announcement comes a lot of fancy new stuff just for you! Including:

🗻 New levels - with the final level that makes it possible to now complete the campaign!
👿 New boss - like a game boss, I, Brain-in-the-jar, am still your boss
💬 New dialogues - because I have so many interesting things to say
🤠 New hats - to represent the D-Corp properly
👍 Improved interface - so you can be better at your job
🐛 Dozens of bugfixes - no more complaining about your performance!

Even I have gotten a fancy new 3D look! Check this out:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/9e6360e0b368b2f47fd425b1cd761c9387792413.gif

Interested in details? Sure thing, we got you covered. Just take a look down below.

And so much more! Lots of other small changes!

Don't tell me the corporate don't ever do anything for you!

Future

What will come in the future?

That depends a lot on you! We at D-Corp are ALWAYS open to your feedback!

Make sure that we stay in touch on Twitter! Or Discord!

Do not leave me hanging! 🧠

We at 🤖 D-Corp 🔨 are proud to let you know that our corporate effort resulted in setting a release date.

Joy, oh joy!

The shiny and polished game is ready to leave the Early Access behind and move on to greater things! Such as providing you with enjoyment and multitasking gameplay galore.

Make sure to let your friends and family know! 📣 After all, you would not want to do all corporate work on your own? Scrapping, turret maintenance, collecting secrets, and more await you!

notes.title: Brave New World
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/63aa8ca1913b820b04e68a6bdda676e68cb6b5c8.png
[previewyoutube=lLRahsvNSdc;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/09fd1d0d48be9fb6ce4b23f933c8ad9d5d7624db.png
Welcome to a Brave New World!
I come bearing great news! Our semi-sentient probes have discovered another area BENEATH the sewers. A secret lab or something. This is a great business opportunity that gives us new ways to collect Cactigen©, as well as getting to the root of these cacti (with perhaps even greater collections of juicy Cactigen©)! D-Corp. will keep throwing our probes down there and see what sticks and/or explodes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/4c50e262a0ee90036aeca85903b07568b3548eba.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/0a562d263e65a9733b89bc945348b5abe6fbdd9c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/a87f7145d588da89288650e569d7938cfa7a8a81.png
This technological marvel has been discovered throughout the “Lab”, and has been given the scientific moniker “Garbage Eater”. Throwing things into the hole at the top converts the object into something else. We can utilize this to convert the mobile cactus quadrupeds into juice canisters of profit! ‘Waste not’ is, after all, company slogan #142-C.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/e1112fb48292ede0f6459e23e68ff1a437f764f1.png
In order to utilize the juice canisters from the “Garbage Eater”, we will provide you with the new ‘Scrap Vice’ device (name trademarked, patent pending). Simply place the juice canister into the device and use your “scrapping device” and “interact” with it until the lid pops open. Proceed to collect the juice, place it in the recycler and send us the profits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/d4529c9b6ffcd07d7c1d345b04b7f59aadb2c17b.png
[strike]In order to assist with power management in the newly discovered lab area, our top scientists have developed this new Ultra-Safe Power Fuse that absorbs power from the system and[/strike]
In order to protect you from mobile flora down there, this newly developed TURRET is purposefully constructed to make use of the inherently unstable power system present in The Lab. It will require power, but will never need to be reloaded as long as that power source is active. (DISCLAIMER: The use of the Tesla Tower might overcharge the system, leading to extreme power failure. Failure to comply with safety regulations can and will result in grievous physical harm and/or a written reprimand.) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

We have also made a few modifications to the Bitbot engine. After discovering that, by reducing the stability matrix to below recommended safety levels, we could actually achieve a mid-jump BOOST. After seven weeks of non-stop focus testing, our marketing department has come up with the title “Double Jump”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/88459553d1e44ff7ed77b201907446a20626cfb4.gif
(unfortunately, this unit didn’t make it)

Time has come to explore and harvest this new area. If you are still reading this, this extra time is considered work hours, and by processing this information you will of course have any extra time deducted from your salary.*

*Bitbots do not have salaries. Any deductions in salary will instead be hard-coded into the shame sub-systems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

We interrupt communications with a message from the head of corporate:
Now would be a great time to get a copy or a wishlist of this product. 
As D-Corp exits Early Access this September*,
 the price tag will increase to match: 16,99€
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/7a887591e20dfac89c3d9073d783c969bddf2edf.png
Don't wait! Save yourself some money

(Or wishlist and wait for the full version.)

*The corporate reserves the right to move the release date if necessary

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/5a7a65481e9ef74ac4b3f618b50dd4c8dcc041c6.png

If you notice any discrepancies in any department, be it audio, visual or mechanical, do not hesitate to contact us through our usual channels and forums. Twitter or Facebook.

Or join the Discord channel!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/e842860305dfd32d5f9c038359d9b6ad3672f4e1.png 

To reiterate. These mobile cacti are nothing but slightly more resistant scrap, and our ethics committee has decided that they are not sentient in any way. Therefore, harvesting them will not be in violation of our primary directives or ethics modules in any discernible way!

Brain-in-a-jar
CEO D-Corp

notes.title: In Control - Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/b4f623b46640be98ed4f3edc5d5960cb5de66bc6.png

Welcome Bit-Bots!

Today, I am proud to present you with the latest news regarding D-Corp! This includes, but is not limited to, drastically improved features as well as brand new content. 

We now tick all the boxes for “Full Controller Support” on Steam. This means that each and every player can control their destiny to the fullest! As a result of this we will no longer need to accept complaints connected to “pits”, “spikes” or “falling into”.

Additionally, we will now distribute proper “compensation” for a “job well done”. By completing the company challenges in a level, you will receive a reward in the form of a glorious hat or hat-like object! Some challenges are more difficult than others, but you can always try again if you fail. You don’t have to succeed on all challenges in one go either! As long as you complete each level challenge at some point, you will be rewarded with the hat of your dreams! After all, “display your success on your head” is one of D-Corp’s many brand philosophies that we take seriously. Make us (and, by extension, yourself) proud by giving 110%!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/fae784ddf9cea2160ded6207077222b0cc6fc457.png

In unrelated news, the company has received complaints regarding “difficulty”, “impossibility” and “I can’t feel my legs, please send help!”. Naturally, we care a lot about our cost-friendly and disposable Bit-Bots, enough to even address some of these complaints. Balancing has been made across the board, especially focused on scenarios with only a single player. More ammunition, fewer hostiles and some environmental balances should improve your experience while collecting our delicious cactus juice. While we still encourage everyone to play the game with friends or even colleagues or acquaintances, we will now aim to make the game less depressing for people playing alone.

If you find ANY issues, please don’t hesitate to contact our Feedback Department using one of the available channels.

Twitter, Discord or Facebook.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38847890/09fd1d0d48be9fb6ce4b23f933c8ad9d5d7624db.png
Brain-in-a-jar
CEO D-Corp

 Updated level markers.

 Sprinkled the surface levels with destructible flowers.
 Updated Ammo UI on all turrets.
 

Gameplay

 Added full controller support.

Thank you for taking the time to read this post. 
We are looking forward to hearing from you and I will continue to post regular updates and a roadmap to show you how we plan to reach a full release. Please don’t be shy on posting feedback on our forums and discord. 

Our most difficult task right now is to nail the difficulty, so if You are having special trouble with a level make sure to tell us.
